title: Tomorrow quick-pass — focus list & loose notes
content:
Quick pass for tomorrow — mix of work todos, errands, and tiny drafts.

Top priorities (2):
- [ ] INF-2413: validate hotfix for batcher deadlock on long-tail seqs — repro steps in ticket, try repro on local cluster (small GPU). If flaky, escalate to SRE.
- [ ] Merge runtime PR #512 after smoke test (latency smoke on ci-small). Coordinate with Marco if CI flakiness shows up.

Quick wins (<15m):
- [ ] Tag PR with "needs-sla-check" if any runtime changes touch routing.
- [ ] Add note to the canary checklist about prefilling KV cache for the demo model.
- [x] Ping Nina about rollout timing (she confirmed EOD today).

Meetings / blocks:
- 09:00 — Standup (prep: 2 bullet points: batcher repro, PR smoke status)
- 11:30 — Sync with Product (15m) on Dedicated autoscale thresholds — bring cost numbers (see last week's budget sheet link in #costs).
- 15:00 — Ops handoff: handover doc + short runbook update (below).

Follow-ups / blocking items:
- Re-run perf test on quantized 7B model with seq_len=2048 (note: use checkpoint v2). Record token/sec and p50 latency.
- Check billing dash for Dedicated pool usage spike from Friday — file a ticket if >10% above forecast.
- Confirm storage encryption for private deployment demo (ask security for KMS ARN).

Errands / personal quick list:
- [ ] Drop off package at UPS (before 17:00).
- [ ] Buy oat milk for office — put on Slack grocery thread.
- [ ] Rotate personal SSH key (then update GitHub) — add reminder: do not rotate infra keys today.

Draft email to partnerships (very rough) — short, send after QA:
Subject: Quick confirmation on Dedicated trial SLA
Hi Sam,

Thanks for the trial feedback — two quick asks: can we confirm the network egress limits for the Dedicated pool? Also, can we schedule a 30-minute session next week to review latency profiles?

Thanks,
Cesar

Notes to self / runbook snippet for handoff:
- If batcher deadlocks: restart service: systemctl restart redwood-batcher (watch logs /var/log/redwood/batcher.log). If not clearing in 2 min, escalate to SRE on-call (pagernum in Slack profile).
- Quick triage: check KV cache hit rate dashboard (Console > Models > kv-cache > last 1h).

Random ideas / backlog seeds:
- Consider a cheap
  "warm-up route" that pumps synthetic prefix to keep cold containers primed during low traffic windows. Track cost delta vs p50 gain.
- Metric: ratio of prefix-cache-hits to total requests per model (might correlate to cost saving).

Open questions to resolve tomorrow:
- Does canary config need explicit fallback to cpu-quantized variant? (ask Product).
- Who owns the billing alert thresholds for Dedicated — finance or infra?

Small reminders:
- Keep PR descriptions minimal but include perf numbers.
- When merging, run smoke for both x86 and aarch64 if possible.

End notes: keep this doc short, transfer checklist items to Jira after morning standup.
